About UltaHost
 UltaHost is a rapidly growing global web hosting and cloud infrastructure provider delivering high-performance hosting, VPS, dedicated servers, and cloud solutions to customers worldwide. Our mission is to provide reliable, scalable, and innovative infrastructure services while maintaining exceptional customer satisfaction. As our global operations continue to expand, we are looking for talented professionals to join our international team and contribute to our long-term growth.
 Job Overview
 UltaHost is looking for a highly skilled Full-Stack JavaScript Developer (AI-Native) to join our Engineering team. This role is ideal for an experienced software engineer who enjoys building modern web applications across the entire technology stack while leveraging AI-assisted development workflows to deliver high-quality software efficiently. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable backend services and modern frontend applications using JavaScript and TypeScript technologies. Working closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers, you will take ownership of features from specification through production while maintaining high standards for code quality, security, and performance.
 Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using Node.js, NestJS, React, Next.js, and TypeScript
Build secure and maintainable REST APIs, authentication systems, and backend services
Design and maintain database schemas using Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL,
MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis where appropriate
Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar as part of your daily development workflow
Collaborate closely with Product, Design, QA, and Engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, Docker-based development environments, and deployment processes
 Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)
4+ years of professional Full-Stack JavaScript development experience
Strong expertise in JavaScript and TypeScript
Production experience with Node.js and NestJS
Strong experience with React and Next.js
Hands-on experience with Prisma ORM, PostgresSQL/MySQL, MongoDB/Redis
Experience with Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines
Experience writing unit and integration tests using Jest, Vitest, Supertest, or similar frameworks
Daily experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex CLI, or similar
Strong understanding of software architecture, scalability, security, and modern engineering best practices
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
 Preferred Qualifications
Experience building AI-powered applications using LLM APIs
Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI agent frameworks, or AI automation
Experience working on SaaS, hosting, cloud, or infrastructure platforms
Experience with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD platforms
Experience optimizing application performance and large-scale systems
Passion for AI-assisted software engineering and continuous improvement
 What We Offer

Career growth and professional development opportunities
